title: Fresh Blender render holdout for rigid Material-owner TOP, BOTTOM and NEITHER domains
question: On fresh Blender 5.2 Cycles rasters, Material tokens and Generated emission signals, do the frozen factor-1 Material-owner one-sided curvature rules accept at least half of the analytically constructed TOP- and BOTTOM-missing target cells, reject every NEITHER-horizontal target cell, and preserve the frozen identity, risk-underbound, quality and fallback contracts in two clean repeats?
decisionRole: targeted rendered confirmation of the D12.14-C2 rigid directional fixtures; even a supported result cannot repair D12.12-H1, reverse D12.13-D1, satisfy the rejected 0.97 global coverage contract or authorize compiler promotion

scientificClassification.targetedFreshMeasurement: The three world-space foreground trajectories come from D12.14-C2 calibration, but raster heights, one TOP width, Material/Object tokens, mesh tessellation, Generated emission coefficients, render seed, output paths and every rendered pass are new after C2.
scientificClassification.pilotInformedConstruction: A disclosed zero-render scalar pilot explored raster phase after C2. It only established that the target structural domains exist; no Blender pass, Material signal, reconstructed RGB, risk, quality or acceptance value was observed.
scientificClassification.frozenIntervention: The factor-1 Material-owner one-sided algorithm, Q30/Q24 scales, inclusive risk threshold, reconstruction order, fallback and quality gates are inherited unchanged from D12.12-H1 before any H1 tool or EXR exists.
scientificClassification.negativeResultValue: Missing rendered target witnesses, insufficient target acceptance, any NEITHER acceptance, quality failure or evidence-chain failure is retained. Fixture transforms, rasters, signals, regions, denominators and gates may not be repaired after rendering.
scientificClassification.d13Boundary: D12.13-D1 already rejected a global threshold-only promotion family. This holdout asks whether the missing directional mechanism is executable on real passes; it does not repeat or override the global coverage derivation.

requirements: This specification, every listed H1 tool path, the preflight root and the formal root are absent when preregistration begins.
This exact specification is committed and pushed before any H1 tool byte, preflight output, formal output or EXR exists.
All eight H1 tools are committed and pushed in a later tool-freeze commit before the formal root exists.

A zero-render preflight may construct scenes, inspect RNA, render-engine settings, pass registration and analytically replay the frozen transforms, but may not invoke render, create the formal root or emit a formal measurement.
Formal output consists of 12 new factory-empty Blender 5.2 Cycles CPU renders. No C2 mask and no D12.12-H1 or D12.13 array is a measurement input.
The C2, D12.12-H1 and D12.13 formal Git trees remain identical before and after H1.
No transform, raster, signal, token, target class, threshold, denominator, operation count, attack family or verdict mapping may change after this commit.

exploratoryGrid.width: C2 selected width minus 8 through plus 8 inclusive in steps of 2
exploratoryGrid.height: C2 selected height minus 8 through plus 8 inclusive in steps of 2
exploratoryGrid.interpretation: The pilot revealed width-phase sensitivity and height robustness. It is disclosed development evidence and is not a blind holdout.

disclosedRasterPilot.nonDecisionBoundary: Only resolution and structural witness counts were observed. The pilot did not construct the new materials, invoke Blender, read any rendered pass, compute factor-1 risk or inspect acceptance/quality.

sceneContract.construction: fresh factory state; one fixed tessellated rigid foreground plane and one fixed background plane per fixture; continuous Generated object-local emission; no source blend, external asset, image texture, light, transparency, deformation, simulation, motion blur, depth of field, compositor or denoiser

ownerTokenContract.objectIndexNegativeControl: Both analytic owners in each fixture deliberately share one Object Index; Object Index must remain byte-stable but may not be a decision input.
ownerTokenContract.materialIndexDecisionInput: Exact finite float32 equality to the declared compiler-assigned integer token.

projectionOracle.cameraConvention: Blender camera looks along local -Z; camera coordinates are transpose(R_camera_XYZ)*(world-cameraLocation)
projectionOracle.currentSurface: cast each current pixel-center ray through the bounded foreground/background planes and select the nearest positive-depth hit
projectionOracle.previousSurfacePoint: map the current foreground hit into owner-local coordinates and apply the same fixed mesh's previous rigid transform
projectionOracle.depth: positive camera-space -Z of the selected surface point

structuralContract.registeredCurrent: finite current RGBA/depth/vector/material; alpha>0.999; declared nonzero current Material Index; analytic current owner exists
structuralContract.bilinearSupport: all four previous taps are in bounds, alpha>0.999 and have exact Material Index equality to the current analytic owner token
structuralContract.predictedDepth: bilinearly sampled previous Depth matches transform-predicted previous-camera depth within max(1,predictedPreviousDepth)/1024
structuralContract.currentInterior: current pixel and every current neighbor within Chebyshev radius 2 have the same exact Material Index and alpha>0.999

outerSupport.left: both rows' x0-1 taps match the current analytic Material owner
outerSupport.right: both rows' x0+2 taps match the current analytic Material owner
outerSupport.top: both columns' y0-1 taps match the current analytic Material owner
outerSupport.bottom: both columns' y0+2 taps match the current analytic Material owner

structuralContract.fallback: every registered pixel outside accepted copies current float32 RGBA exactly
forbidden: Object Index equality as owner identity
pilot mask or analytic class as a consumer decision input
current/future RGB as a consumer decision input

frozenCandidate.name: MATERIAL_OWNER_ONE_SIDED_D2_FACTOR_1
frozenCandidate.horizontalRule: Per bilinear row, use max(left,right) when both same-owner Q30 second differences exist, the single absolute difference multiplied by exactly 1 when one exists, and reject when neither exists.
frozenCandidate.verticalRule: Per bilinear column, use max(top,bottom) when both same-owner Q30 second differences exist, the single absolute difference multiplied by exactly 1 when one exists, and reject when neither exists.
frozenCandidate.riskFormula: riskQ30 = ceil(2*(Fx*(2^24-Fx)*Mx + Fy*(2^24-Fy)*My)/2^48)+512, saturated to uint32 maximum independently per RGB channel
frozenCandidate.acceptance: recomputed structural and radius-2 domains, common bilinear Material support, horizontal and vertical curvature support, and max RGB riskQ30 <= 131072 inclusive
frozenCandidate.reconstruction: four-tap previous RGBA bilinear graph ((v0*w0+v1*w1)+v2*w2)+v3*w3 in binary64 with one final float32 cast
frozenCandidate.fullStencilIdentity: where the symmetric 4x4 Material/alpha stencil is valid, risk, accepted and reconstructed bytes equal an independently recomputed D12.11 symmetric baseline

directionalMeasurementContract.analysisOnly: Directional classes are independently recomputed after decisions from formal pass-derived owner arrays. Pilot masks may not be read by a source, adapter, consumer, analyzer or auditor.

classes.TOP_MISSING_BOTTOM_AVAILABLE: both bilinear columns lack a valid top outer tap and have a valid bottom outer tap; both horizontal rows retain full left+right support
classes.BOTTOM_MISSING_TOP_AVAILABLE: both bilinear columns lack a valid bottom outer tap and have a valid top outer tap; both horizontal rows retain full left+right support
classes.NEITHER_HORIZONTAL_AVAILABLE: common four-tap Material support is valid but at least one required row has neither a valid left nor right outer tap

directionalMeasurementContract.measurementRegion: the full frame; no post-render crop is allowed
directionalMeasurementContract.denominator: every formal pass-derived cell in the fixture's frozen directional class; no risk reject, support reject or quality failure may be dropped

requiredFamilies: C2, D12.12-H1 and D12.13 parent byte and formal-tree mutations

source EXR, source report, adapter payload, adapter report and multipart roster mutations
Material Index zero, reuse, swap, undeclared and out-of-range mutations
Object Index divergence from the shared negative control and Object/Material channel substitution
foreground mesh identity, scale, transform, raster and Generated-signal mutations

NEITHER witness suppression, acceptance injection and fallback mutation

attacks.independence: The auditor may use Python standard library and NumPy but may not import Blender modules or any source, adapter, consumer, analyzer or runner implementation. Every counted attack mutates one isolated in-memory semantic payload and must trigger at least one named gate.

decision.supportedWhen: Every identity, source, repeat, cross-language, projection, structural, token, safety, quality, fallback, TOP/BOTTOM directional, NEITHER negative-control, audit and attack gate passes in both clean repeats.
decision.directionFailureWhen: All identity and safety gates pass, but TOP or BOTTOM misses its frozen witness/acceptance gate or NEITHER lacks its minimum formal witness. Any NEITHER acceptance is not a direction-only failure and maps to rejected.
decision.rejectedWhen: Any parent, freshness, runtime, process, source, repeat, cross-language, mesh, token, projection, structural, risk-underbound, quality, alias, false-invalid, fallback, NEITHER acceptance, audit-totality or attack gate fails.
decision.promotionBoundary: A supported verdict only establishes the targeted TOP/BOTTOM/NEITHER mechanism on these fresh opaque rigid-planar emission fixtures. D12.13-D1 still blocks threshold-only compiler promotion; the next permissible work is a separately preregistered risk-tightness decomposition or a broader fresh holdout.

nonClaims: The raster pilot is construction evidence, not a confirmatory measurement and not evidence of raster-phase robustness outside the explored grid.
This experiment does not provide a mathematical error bound for arbitrary rendered functions.

The fixtures are opaque, rigid, planar, emission-only surfaces and do not establish curved or deforming geometry, transparency, hair, volumes, lighting, shadows, denoising, motion blur or depth of field.
Pixel error gates do not establish perceptual importance or cinematic quality.
The shared Object Index is a negative control; success cannot be attributed to Object Index ownership.
A supported verdict does not satisfy the rejected 0.97 global coverage or 0.95 per-owner retention contracts and does not enter the production compiler.
No verdict retroactively changes D12.12-H1, D12.13-D1 or D12.14-C2.
